name: Penguin Slide
oneLine: Tap a penguin to belly-slide it and knock every penguin in its path into the sea.
diffTitle: A blocked penguin is not a dead end
diffText: In most arrow puzzles a piece stuck behind another is a dead end. Here the slider shoves the whole line ahead of it, so one smart tap can splash five or six penguins at once.
s1d: The penguin belly-slides the way it faces.
s2d: Every penguin in its path gets shoved along.
s3d: Penguins pushed off the floe swim to your island and grow your colony.
market: Arrow and tap-away puzzles keep charting; most use plain blocks or cars.
hook: Chain pushes: one tap can clear a whole row, a moment that is easy to read in one second.
ad: Opening shot: a single tap sends a line of penguins splashing into the sea.
monet: Rewarded hints and undo, limited taps, colony meta (collect rare penguins, decorate the island).
statusFact: Playable web prototype with 7 levels and a solver-based level generator. Unity build in 2–3 weeks.
note: Early web prototype to test the core mechanic. Placeholder art and no sound yet; the production build will be made in Unity.
